integrity: Exact finite enumerations are supporting tests; the unrestricted theorem is proved by rotation moment arithmetic, fixed-weight hypergeometric block counting, and inclusion-exclusion.
scientific_limitations: Uniformly sampled labeled fixed-weight binary words, rather than uniform necklaces; only two-binomial profiles; fixed-gcd interior-density asymptotic; no multiletter or error-correcting claim. Novelty is conditional on accessible literature; no independent audit.
title: Exact rotational \(2\)-binomial profile diversity at fixed binary composition
